# ThemeForest

> > ThemeForest is a premium marketplace for WordPress themes, website templates, and design resources across multiple platforms including Shopify, WooCommerce, and Elementor.

ThemeForest is part of the Envato ecosystem and serves as the largest marketplace for professionally-designed website templates and themes. The platform offers thousands of responsive, multipurpose themes compatible with various CMS platforms and ecommerce solutions.

## Key Topics

- WordPress themes
- Website templates
- Elementor
- WooCommerce
- Shopify themes
- Responsive design
- Ecommerce templates
- Theme marketplace
- Multipurpose themes
- CMS templates
- Web design

- Envato
- Managed WordPress hosting

## Browse & Discover

- [Homepage](https://themeforest.net): ThemeForest homepage: premium WordPress, Shopify & WooCommerce templates marketplace
- [Featured Files](https://themeforest.net/feature): Showcase of featured premium themes for WordPress, Elementor, and other platforms
- [Browse Categories](https://themeforest.net/category): Category directory for browsing website templates and themes by type
- [Public Collections](https://themeforest.net/collections): Curated collections of themes, templates and design resources from community
- [User Feed](https://themeforest.net/follow_feed): User feed for discovering WordPress, Shopify and WooCommerce templates

## Elementor & Page Builders

- [Elementor Templates & Themes](https://themeforest.net/elementor): Elementor template kits, plugins and WordPress themes from ThemeForest
- [Elementor-Compatible Themes](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/elementor): 7,335+ Elementor-compatible WordPress themes and website templates

## Ecommerce Solutions

- [WooCommerce Themes](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/facebook): 718 Facebook-compatible WordPress and WooCommerce themes
- [Drupal Commerce Templates](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/Drupal%20Commerce): 71 Drupal Commerce ecommerce themes and website templates
- [Ecwid Integration Templates](https://themeforest.net/attributes/themeforest-files-included/ecwid%20css%20files): 143 Ecwid-compatible WordPress themes for ecommerce and health/beauty
- [Ubercart Templates](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/Ubercart): 10 Ubercart Drupal ecommerce themes and website templates
